issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returns a double, but the solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning an int. This creates a return-type mismatch between the specification and the provided solution and can cause confusion or test failures (and integer division issues) for students who implement the method according to the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the UML by changing the method signature in the solution (and in any tests or template hints) to public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(), and compute the value using floating-point division, e.g. return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors();. Alternatively, if integer return type is intended, update the UML and problem description to state an int return type and clarify integer division semantics.
